newsitem.title: USA: INSTANT VIEW - US industrial output flat in January.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - US industrial output flat in January.

text.p: Following are comments from U.S. economists after the Federal Reserve reported industrial production was flat in January compared to a revised 0.5 percent jump in December. Economists had forecast a rise of 0.1 percent.
The Fed also reported capacity utilization fell to 83.3 percent in January from 83.5 percent in December. Economists had expected a drop to 83.4 percent.
WAYNE AYERS, CHIEF ECONOMIST BANK OF BOSTON: "I think it's a little early to look at this number and get positive confirmation that a slowdown is at hand."
